context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features tested and working: 1) Geofencing CRUD (create/list/toggle/delete/check), 2) ECG recording with waveform display and history, 3) Sedentarity settings and check. Frontend routes /ecg and /geofencing are working. Home dashboard has 'Lancer ECG' and 'Zones sécurité' quick actions. Profile page has ECG and Geofencing shortcuts. Note: Expo needed restart after initial test for routes to work.

Sedentarity check only creates alerts during configured hours (8-22) if last device reading is older than max_inactive_hours
